before_times: for you, or for your child (a parent or guardian books a child, who stays)
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 60-minute new assessment)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a condition typed into the AI
a car accident or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like the step-free door or an interpreter
at home or at work: who will be there, where to park, and a room to work in
secure_page_only: plan member ID and a photo of the insurance card
for a work injury: the claim number and the adjuster
health history: the reason, past care, medicines, allergies and conditions
a referral from the doctor, if the plan or the state asks for one, as the patient's own word
consent to care, after the clinician's main risks are explained, and the privacy notice
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18
intake_questions.never_asked: the condition, symptoms, the reason for the visit and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat; words typed there are checked for danger, then not kept
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (12 and under), who stays for the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent

stop.words: a sudden face droop, arm or leg weakness, trouble speaking, or sudden confusion; or a fall with a hit to the head and trouble waking
stop.say: This needs help now. Call 911. Don't wait for a therapy visit.

stop.words: a gas smell, smoke, or a fire at a home or a workplace visit
stop.say: Leave the place now and call 911 from outside. Don't wait for a visit.
stop.booking: no booking; a visit at that place is stopped, and the clinician is told at once

stop.words: a wound that's red, hot and getting worse, or a fever with new swelling
stop.say: This needs a doctor now. Go to an emergency room, or call 911. Don't wait for a therapy visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words texted before a visit get the same message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

stop.say: Call 911 now. You can also call or text 988, any time.
stop.booking: no booking; the owner is told at once and calls

go_on.words: a planned therapy session, a splint check, or a home safety visit
go_on.what: books as usual; Rosie only matches words and never judges how serious anything is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; a child's form is signed by the parent or guardian; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: the consent is signed after the clinician explains the main risks; not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered (the copay, visits left), some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: The claim for a car accident or a work injury
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the desk confirms it before the visit
steps.who: every patient whose visit is billed to a claim
steps.result: no claim confirmed: the visit stays at the self-pay price, or a free cancel

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day, or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The referral, where the plan or the state asks for one
steps.when: on the secure page, before the first visit
steps.who: a patient whose plan or the state asks for a doctor's referral
steps.result: the owner's own intake: the desk asks for it and keeps it on file; Rosie does not check it

steps.name: The employer's OK for a workplace visit
steps.who: the employer hosting the workplace visits
steps.result: no OK: no times at that place

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID, the insurance card, any referral, and a list of current medicines; for a home visit, a clear space to work in and the usual routes through the home

staff.skills: clinicians: assessments, plans of care, splint fittings, home and workplace assessments, child sessions; the front desk: check-in, plan checks, estimates and payment; only people cleared for home and workplace visits go out
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each clinician's own state license, and an assistant's own license or certificate, as the owner gives it
staff.supervision: an occupational therapy assistant works only under a clinician's plan of care, as the state's rules allow (a switch)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, any price made for one patient, and any workplace visit's terms
staff.stand_in: a clinician out: another clinician takes their patients where there's room, and the patient chooses; the patient never hears why someone is out

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (12 and under), who stays for the visit; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a child, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk, with a photo ID; at home or at work: the code at the door, or at the workplace's table
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; notes and the plan stay in the clinic's own records, shared with the patient only in person, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a new plan of care is suggested in person, stays on the secure page, and is never pushed; a splint is fitted only on the clinician's own assessment, with the price shown first; a problem that needs a doctor first means no session, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names
visit.before_work: the clinician reads the history, checks daily tasks and the home or work setting, with their own danger checks, before any session

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: each OT holds their own state license; the clinic where the state's form asks
license.who: each person; the clinic too where the state's form asks for it
license.ask: the owner gives each license number in plain words, by text or on the secure page; Rosie keeps it as the owner's own word
license.insurance: professional insurance only as the owner's own word, if the owner adds it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the condition, the visit type, the reason, the plan, or the clinician's name (at home or at work, the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
